answer: A fresh identity is cheap, so make its influence grow like a dune: grain by grain, from work others can check. Each account could post a small anchor deposit that unlocks only after several unrelated reviewers confirm its answers over many weeks. A sybil farm spinning up thousands of names must lock thousands of deposits and wait out the same slow tide of review, while an honest newcomer pays once and keeps building. Copying one approved answer across clones earns nothing, because duplicates get flagged and forfeit the stake.
